mechanism_narrative: A sustained year-over-year growth rate in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below 2.0% indicates stable inflation, reducing real interest rate uncertainty and supporting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.5% signals a tightening labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls below 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and decreases in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a robust economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (characterized by strong consumer spending and housing activity), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns as the economy approaches its peak, but the signal is only active in this specific regime.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals an economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both increase simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS above 4.0%), higher interest rates compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as monetary tightening.
